dict.string: Connect to your MDM, pick the sections you want, and get a polished, branded audit report. Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune and Iru are all supported over read-only API access, with no queries to write. The report is a single self-contained HTML file with search, filtering and a clean print layout. You can also export it as PDF or Word, add a written guidance document, or schedule it to run unattended. Nothing is written back to your MDM, and all data stays on your Mac.
